meta.reset: Reset DB, cache and search index to `fixtures` before every case. Seed fixtures.locales first, then fixtures.categories: one object per translation (the domain Category: slug, hidden, navbar, locale, name). hidden and navbar are shared per slug, so every row of a slug repeats the same values; the loader should assert that rows of one slug agree. Actor rows are seeded by the harness; inject sessions directly.
meta.actor: Key into fixtures.actors, or: anonymous, garbage_session, expired_session. Actor caps are per entity: caps.categories = [create, edit, delete]; root also holds caps.locales = [create, delete] for the cross-system cases. Listing, reading and searching need only a valid session.
meta.request: path_params are unescaped and must be percent-encoded when substituted. Accept-Language is sent only when a case sets it. headers: null removes a default header. A request with a body carries Content-Type: application/json unless overridden. body_generator {json_padded_bytes: N, base} = valid JSON of exactly N bytes, padded with an unknown field.
meta.json_assertions: ops used: type (incl. boolean), eq, len_eq, gte, includes, excludes, sorted_asc, sorted_desc. Paths with [*] resolve to lists; filter paths like $.categories[?(@.slug=='news')].name must match exactly one element.
meta.eventually_ms: Retry the step until it passes or the timeout elapses (search indexing is async).
meta.source: documented = rules inside the source_document; stated = rules you gave outside it (413, 415, 409, 401); inferred = derived from conventions or from the users and locales tests.
meta.tags: boundary, cache, security, regression, undocumented_limit, needs_bulk, cross_system (touches /cms/locales), verify_normalisation, verify_slug_rules (slug charset, hyphen rules, 128 cap), verify_name_rules (trim, required, length, uniqueness), verify_defaults (hidden/navbar default to false), verify_shared_flags (flags are per category, not per translation), verify_locale_precedence (body locale vs Accept-Language), verify_locale_validation (locale must exist in the cms record), verify_accept_language (q-values, region subtags, wildcard, missing header), verify_hidden_visibility (admin API returns hidden categories), verify_patch_new_translation (PATCH with a locale that has no translation needs a name), verify_patch_create_perm (which capability creating a translation through PATCH needs), verify_patch_conflict (409 on slug rename), verify_noop, verify_cascade (category disappears with its last translation), verify_sortable (name and slug sortable; hidden, navbar, locale not), verify_clamp, verify_doc_typo (count defaults to 1), verify_reserved_slug (slug `search` vs the search route), verify_bodiless (Content-Type and size handling on GET/DELETE), verify_check_order.
